senses.gloss:
काय काय,
 I. (base क, a name of the god Prajāpati).
 1. m. A nuptial form called Prājāpatya, Man. 3, 38.
 2. n. The root of the little finger, Man. 2, 59.
 II. i. e. चि + अ, m. The body, Bhag. 5, 11.
 --Comp.
कायस्थ काय-स्थ (vb. स्था), m. A mixed tribe or caste, the writer caste; a writer, Rājat. 5, 174; 264; 438.

कायिक कायिक, i. e. काय + इक, adj., f. का (Man. 8, 153) and की.
 1. Corporeal, bodily Man. 12, 8; Suśr. 1, 12, 2.
 2. (viz. वृद्धि, Immoderate profits) from a pledge to be used by way of interest, Man. 8, 153.
